supersession_reason: v1 did not capture environment reset observations before set_init_state and therefore could not diagnose whether evaluator fixed-state injection erased seed effects; no GPU execution occurred under v1.
primary_question: After fixing the evaluator call order, does env_seed 0 vs 1 produce repeatable changes in actual policy-visible inputs under the same task/reset?
primary_variable: env_seed 0 vs 1; evaluator applies model seed first and LIBERO environment seed second
policy_input_checks: raw two-view images and robot state
same evaluator prepare_observation resized images and 7D proprio
center-cropped two-view processor pixel_values (BF16 values represented exactly in FP32 for hashing), input_ids, attention_mask
normalized proprio using frozen checkpoint statistics

admission_gate.within_seed_repeat: all recorded model inputs repeat exactly (or below preregistered renderer noise floor)
admission_gate.across_seed_change: actual processor-level image or normalized proprio changes beyond same-seed noise in at least 8/10 tasks at query0 and remains reproducibly different after 8 no-op steps
admission_gate.task_validity: no pre-solved reset, early done, or simulator error

stop_conditions: modified helper import or SHA mismatch
seed call order differs from the versioned patch
policy-visible input does not exceed same-seed noise
task/reset invalid or no-op rollout errors
post_stage_action: If seed smoke passes, pre-register C0/C3 paired micro on the unchanged 10 task/reset set; otherwise isolate whether set_init_state overwrites reset-seeded variation and do not launch C0/C3 env-seed evaluation.
bf16_gate: No 10/10 requirement; the completed 9/10 BF16 result remains ancillary and task 4 is not excluded.
